Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: residential concept photo, landscape 1536x1024. Edit the attached living room in exactly the same camera and architecture. This is an understated, attainable home inspired by warm travel craftsmanship, NOT a designer-brand showroom. KEEP the warm cream walls, cognac leather sofa, cream oval stone coffee table, beige rug, lights, window openings, ceiling beams, room dimensions and furniture positions.
REMOVE every flower/star/diamond monogram, brand-like pattern, luggage trunk, luggage clasp, metal riveted corner and strap-like cabinet handle. Replace the monogram trunk next to the coffee table with a small elegant round-ended walnut side cabinet, seamless curved front, one discreet drawer and recessed plinth, no metal corners. TV cabinetry stays cream with warm walnut plain niche, slim muted bronze reveal, no patterned bands. Rear sideboard becomes quiet walnut with finely reeded sliding fronts and rounded edge, no luggage hardware.
Create OUR OWN very subtle 'arcade path' repeat only on ONE cognac cushion: two offset nested open U-shaped arches and an asymmetric short horizontal stitch, tiny low-contrast tan-on-cognac woven pattern. No flower, four-petal, star, diamond or lettering. All other fabrics mostly plain with tactile weave.
At left remove the busy cut-out decorative glass screen; preserve the exact opening position and width, use a simple clean walnut reveal with softly rounded inner upper corners and plain transparent glazing if needed, no lattice. Leave view and daylight open.
Editorial natural daylight, refined real materials, restrained highlights, clear bright home. No text, logo, watermark. Preserve 3:2 full composition.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: residential interior concept, landscape 1536x1024. Perform ONE tightly bounded renovation to the reference image. The decorative fretwork GLASS SCREEN at left, between the TV wall cabinetry and dining wall, is overused. REMOVE this floral cut-out screen and its metal/glass leaf entirely. Reinterpret the same existing doorway as a clean open passage with a slim honey-walnut lining, gently rounded inner upper corners, no lattice, no glass screen. A light ivory linen curtain gathers neatly to one side inside the reveal; most of the opening remains clear and daylight-filled. Do not widen the structural opening or move any wall/beam. Keep the view of the plant beyond. Do not add shelves blocking passage.
CRITICAL KEEP EVERYTHING ELSE: olive scalloped sofa on right, floral relief wall, cream and cane full-height TV storage, rear full-height floral/cane DINING CABINET with central tea niche, RECTANGULAR pull-out dining table with bronze U-shaped bridge leg and two cane chairs, petal pendant, coffee table, carpet, ceiling, camera and proportions. This is the current cabinet version, do NOT restore a round dining table. Preserve lighting and tasteful bright cream, olive, honey, burgundy palette. No text/logo/watermark. Photorealistic high-end interior, 3:2.
